ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)
opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
protocol_type: Framed serial converter-link protocol. Converter samples are mapped into N'-bit words, packed S samples/converter into F-octet frames and K frames into a multiframe, optionally scrambled (1+x^14+x^15), line-coded (8b/10b for 204B, 64b/66b for 204C) and serialized across L lanes. Bring-up runs CGS (/K28.5/ commas) -> ILAS (four multiframes with the link-config octets) -> user data; the LMFC/multiframe boundary drives lane alignment and deterministic latency.

channels.name: Serial lanes (L differential pairs)
channels.direction: unidirectional (converter->logic for ADC; logic->converter for DAC)
channels.description: 8b/10b (204B) or 64b/66b (204C) line-coded NRZ CML, AC-coupled, up to 12.5 Gbps (204B) / 32 Gbps (204C); embedded clock recovered by the lane CDR.

channels.name: Device Clock (DEVCLK)
channels.description: Common master clock; frame clock and LMFC derived from it.

channels.name: SYSREF
channels.description: Deterministic-latency timing reference that aligns the LMFC; single / periodic / gapped-periodic; sampled by DEVCLK.

channels.name: SYNC~ (active-low)
channels.description: Synchronization request: assert to request CGS, de-assert to start ILAS; also error reporting. In 204C the SYNC function moves into the sync header / command channel.

channels.name: Command channel (JESD204C, optional)
channels.description: In-band control/status signaling in the 64b/66b link layer.

bring_up_phases.description: RX asserts SYNC~; TX streams continuous /K28.5/ commas; RX CDR locks and achieves character (code-group) alignment; after the required consecutive /K/ on all lanes RX de-asserts SYNC~.

On the next multiframe boundary TX sends four multiframes. MF1/3/4: /R/(K28.0) ... /A/(K28.3). MF2: /R/(K28.0) /Q/(K28.4) <link configuration octets> ... /A/(K28.3). Aligns all lanes and conveys the link config for RX verification.
User converter samples, optionally scrambled, with /A/ at multiframe boundaries and /F/ at frame boundaries for alignment monitoring and realignment.

frame_structure.sample_word_bits: N' (N resolution + CS control + tail/dummy; multiple of 4)
frame_structure.high_density: HD flag — a sample may span lane boundaries

control_characters.R: K28.0 (start of multiframe in ILAS / data)
control_characters.Q: K28.4 (start of link configuration data in ILAS multiframe 2)

control_characters_note: These /K/R/A/Q/F/ control characters are 8b/10b (JESD204B/A) constructs. JESD204C's 64b/66b link layer uses the 2-bit sync header and multiblock / extended-multiblock alignment instead of /K/A/F/ characters.
link_configuration_octets: DID (device ID), BID (bank ID), LID (lane ID)
ADJCNT / ADJDIR / PHADJ (Subclass 2 LMFC phase adjust)

line_coding.jesd204c: 64b/66b (optional 64b/80b): 2-bit sync header block alignment, ~97% efficiency, optional Reed-Solomon FEC, command channel

deterministic_latency.subclass_1: SYSREF aligns the LMFC at TX and RX
deterministic_latency.mechanism: LMFC (period F*K frame clocks) + receiver elastic buffer released at the LMFC boundary

addressing.note: JESD204 is an addressless streaming converter link; data is ordered by lane / converter / sample position within the frame and multiframe, not by an address.

frame_format.lane_framing: 8b/10b characters (204B) framed into F-octet frames and K-frame multiframes; /A/ at multiframe boundary, /F/ at frame boundary.
frame_format.block_framing_204c: 64b/66b blocks with a 2-bit sync header; 32 blocks per multiblock; extended-multiblock alignment.
frame_format.ilas_framing: Four multiframes; MF2 carries the link-config octets between /Q/(K28.4) and /A/(K28.3).
